baseline_repeat.interpretation: Cross-process bitwise instability also occurs on untouched baseline; low-level numerical cause uninvestigated. Alternating within-process comparisons are separately reported.

limitations: One v3hc checkpoint, two Ada GPUs and this local runtime; no multi-user workspace slots.
Fixed-work synthetic AR evaluates but ignores EOS; those sequences are not speech quality samples.
No GPU clock lock; paired latency controls ordering drift but is not a universal no-regression guarantee.
PyTorch allocated/reserved metrics and storage deduplication are not board-wide nvidia-smi memory.
Single lazy 448 graph increases KV from 21 to 48 MiB; 17-graph production precapture decreases it from 561 to 48 MiB.
Raw reports remain in ignored local output; this artifact contains hashes and sanitized summary evidence only.

small_fa2_control.conclusion: Occurs without nested layout; low-level cause unresolved. Final CUDA regression uses production head dimension 32 and aligned buckets, fixed shared inputs and per-step logits. No production Flash implementation change retained.
